$comment: Text pool for the Comfort/Grief prayer category.
requests: Comfort for my family. We lost my grandmother on Sunday.
My dad passed away last week. I would appreciate your prayers.
Peace for my coworker, who just lost her husband.
Today would have been my mom's birthday. Missing her.
Our dog of fourteen years died this week. We are heartbroken.
Pray for a friend who lost her brother suddenly.
My husband went home to be with the Lord last month after a long illness. The house is so quiet now. Pray for comfort, and for me to learn how to do life without him.
Our family is planning a funeral this weekend for my father-in-law. There are so many decisions to make. Pray for peace, for patience with each other, and for the service to honor him.
My best friend from high school passed away unexpectedly. We had talked just a few days before. I keep thinking of things I wish I had said. Pray for comfort for me and for her family.
It has been one year since we lost our son. The anniversary is harder than I expected. Pray for my husband and me, and for our daughter, who misses her big brother.
We lost our baby early in the pregnancy last month. We had already started dreaming about who this little one would be. Pray for gentle healing for our hearts.
My grandpa passed away this morning. He was the one who first took me to church. Pray for my grandma, who was married to him for 61 years.
A coworker of mine lost her mom to cancer this week. She is the oldest and is handling all the arrangements. Pray for her strength and for space to grieve.
Grief comes in waves. My wife passed two years ago, and this week has been a hard one. Pray for comfort and for me to feel God's presence again.
Our neighbors lost their teenage son in an accident. We do not know them well, but our hearts are broken for them. Pray for comfort and for us to know how to help.
Asking for prayer for my mom. Her sister, my aunt, passed away last week, and they were very close. Mom is having a hard time.
My father died back in Ohio, and I could not get there in time to say goodbye. I am flying out for the service. Pray for peace and for safe travel.
For my children, who just lost their grandfather. This is their first real experience with death, and they have big questions. Pray for wisdom as we talk with them.
The holidays are coming, and this will be the first without my mom. I am dreading it. Pray for comfort and for our family to find ways to remember her well.
A dear friend lost her husband very suddenly. She has three young kids. Pray for comfort, for provision, and for the church to surround her.
Our cat of eighteen years passed away. I know it is not the same as losing a person, but she was family. Pray for comfort for my kids and me.
My mother-in-law passed peacefully in her sleep. We are sad but grateful she is no longer in pain. Pray for my husband, who was very close to her.
It has been six months since my dad died, and everyone else seems to have moved on. I still miss him every day. Pray that I do not feel so alone in it.
Comfort for my sister, who had a miscarriage last week. She does not want to talk about it yet. Pray for her and her husband, and for me to know how to love her well.
My wife's grandmother passed away at 97. She lived a full life and loved Jesus. Pray for our family as we gather and celebrate her.
We lost a dear member of our small group this week. She was the one who always brought everyone together. Pray for her husband and for our group as we grieve.
Today marks five years since my brother passed. Some years it gets easier. This year it has not. Pray for my parents especially.
Lifting up a family on our street who lost their dad. He was always outside waving at the kids. Pray for his wife and children.
We said goodbye to our faithful old dog this week. The kids are taking it hard. Pray for comfort, and for us to help them through their first big loss.
My uncle passed away suddenly, and my dad is taking it very hard. They were close growing up. Pray for comfort for my dad and for our whole family.
Grief has been heavier around the anniversary of my mom's passing. Pray for comfort and peace this month.
One of my coworkers lost his wife this week. Our whole office is grieving with him. Pray for him and their kids, and for us to support him well when he returns.
My husband lost his best friend from the Army last week. He has not said much, but I can tell it is weighing on him. Pray for comfort and for him to open up.
Peace for our family as we lay my grandfather to rest on Saturday. Pray for the service and for my grandma, who is so tired.

My mom passed away three weeks ago after a long illness. I was her caregiver for the last two years, and now I do not know what to do with my days. I am grieving her, but I am also grieving the routine, the purpose, and the closeness we had at the end. Pray for comfort, for direction, and for me to remember that God is still with me in the quiet.

Our family lost my father-in-law very suddenly last week. He was healthy, active, and still working. There was no warning, and we are all in shock. My husband is the oldest and is trying to hold everyone together. Pray for comfort for his mom, for my husband to have room to grieve too, and for our kids, who adored their grandpa.

This week would have been our 40th wedding anniversary. My husband passed away almost two years ago, and I thought I was doing better. But the days leading up to this have been so heavy. Pray for comfort and for me to feel God's nearness. 'Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.' (Matthew 5:4, WEB)

We lost our baby at 20 weeks. The doctors said there was nothing we could have done, and I am trying to believe that. My husband and I are holding on to each other and to God, but some days are very hard. Pray for gentle healing for our hearts, for our marriage, and for the friends who do not know what to say.

A close friend of mine passed away after a long battle with cancer. She fought so hard and never lost her faith. I am grateful she is with Jesus, but I miss her terribly. She leaves behind a husband and two teenage daughters. Pray for her family, for comfort in the empty places, and for those of us who loved her to keep showing up for them.

My grandmother raised me, and she passed away on Thursday. She taught me to pray, to cook, and to forgive. I am leading the family through the funeral plans because there is no one else to do it. Pray for strength, for peace among the relatives, and for me to have time to actually grieve once the service is over.
details: Some days are okay, and some days the sadness catches us by surprise.
We are leaning on God and on each other more than ever.
The cards and meals from our church family have meant so much.
Pray for good memories to bring comfort instead of only pain.
The quiet moments are the hardest, especially in the evenings.
We know grief takes time, and we are trying to be patient with ourselves.
Remember everyone who is hurting, each grieving in their own way.
We take comfort knowing this is not the end of the story.
There is so much to do, and it is hard to find room to just be sad.
Asking for peace in the empty places this loss has left behind.
Thank you for remembering us. It helps to know we are not alone.
Rest has been hard to find since the loss, so pray for good sleep.
We are grateful for the time we had, even as we miss what we hoped for.
God has been close, even when we did not have words to pray.
Pray for comfort in the weeks ahead, after the calls and visits slow down.
answers: Thank you for praying. We have felt God's comfort in ways we cannot explain.
Still grieving, but there is peace now in the middle of it.
Your prayers carried us through the hardest days. We are so grateful.
Some days are still hard, but the heaviness has lifted a little.
We are finding our way, one day at a time. Thank you for not forgetting us.
God has been near. The cards and texts meant more than you know.
Peace has come slowly, but it has come. Thank you, church family.
Still missing them every day, but we are not walking through it alone.
Comfort has come in small, kind ways. Thank you for every prayer.
Grief is still here, but so is hope. We feel held.
We have had more good days than hard ones lately. Thank you for praying.
The ache is still there, but so is a deep peace we did not expect.
